section_summary.extract_value: This Participants section describes a single study of 247 Black female adolescents (PWI n = 38; HBCUs n = 209) conducted in the southeastern U.S. The mean age was 17.8 years (SD = 0.47) and the mean BMI was 25.4 kg/m2 (SD = 6.4); BMI category percentages are reported (6.5% underweight, 51% normal weight, 20% overweight, 22.4% obese). No information is provided about assessment of body appreciation, correlations between body appreciation and BMI, or whether BMI was measured versus self-reported.
section_summary.evidence_source: Two hundred forty-seven Black female adolescents admitted to either a state-funded predominantly White institution (PWI; n = 38) or one of two Historically Black Colleges and Universities (HBCUs; n = 209) located in the southeastern U.S. participated in this study. The mean age of the sample was 17.8 years (SD = 0.47). The sample's mean BMI was 25.4 kg/m2 (SD = 6.4). The BMI distribution for the sample was as follows: 6.5% underweight, 51% normal weight, 20% overweight, and 22.4% obese.
